cases.title: Home has the Puja Samagri tile; /puja shows the 15 category chips, the filters and the Nearby link (desktop and phone)
cases.preconditions: Signed out. A desktop browser and a phone-size screen (Pixel 7).
cases.steps:
1. Open the home page
2. Find the category tile “Puja Samagri” and read its link
3. Open /puja
4. Read the heading, the category chips and the filter labels
5. Read the “📍 Puja shops near me” link
6. Repeat on the phone
cases.expected: The tile (data-key “puja”) links to /puja. /puja has the heading “🪔 Puja Samagri”, the chips “All” plus 15 categories (among them “Agarbatti & Dhoop”, “Kapur (Camphor)”, “Havan Samagri”, “Ready Puja Kits”, “Temple Bulk Supplies (B2B)”), the filters “Search”, “Festival”, “Loose / packed”, “Min ₹”, “Max ₹” (with “In stock” and “Apply”), the result line “<n> items”, and “📍 Puja shops near me” → /shops/nearby?type=PUJA_SAMAGRI. No sideways scroll on the phone.

cases.title: /puja search in English, Hindi and Marathi and every filter answer a page, never an error
cases.preconditions: Signed out. Result numbers depend on the puja listings on the site (TC-PUJA-014 checks them with data).
cases.steps:
1. Open /puja?q= with each of: kapur, कपूर, कापूर, मोमबत्ती, camphor, agarbathi
2. Open /puja with each filter: festival=diwali, kind=loose, kind=packed, min=10&max=500, stock=1, cat=puja-kapur, cat=puja-phool-patte&kind=loose
3. Read the result line each time
cases.expected: Every URL answers 200 and shows the result line “<n> items” (or “No puja items match these filters yet.”); no error page for any query or filter, Devanagari included.

cases.title: Nearby has a Puja Samagri chip that keeps puja shops only (type=PUJA_SAMAGRI)
cases.preconditions: Signed out. A device position in Pune centre (lat 18.5204, lng 73.8567), not a typed PIN (a PIN is found only from the site's own addresses).
cases.steps:
1. Open /shops/nearby?type=PUJA_SAMAGRI
2. GET /api/shops/nearby?lat=18.5204&lng=73.8567&radiusKm=10
3. The same with &type=PUJA_SAMAGRI
4. The same with &type=puja;drop
cases.expected: Heading “Puja Samagri shops nearby”; chip “🪔 Puja Samagri” selected (aria-current=page) next to “All shops”; link “Puja products →”. Steps 2–3 answer 200; the puja list is never longer than the full list and holds only shops whose main type is Puja Samagri or that added it (e.g. a bakery that took the catalogue). A malformed type answers 422.

cases.title: Every puja API refuses a caller without a session (401) before reading the request
cases.preconditions: Signed out; any UUID (e.g. all zeros) for the shop and product ids.
cases.steps:
1. Call, signed out: GET and PATCH /api/admin/puja/config; GET and POST /api/admin/puja/submissions; GET /api/admin/puja/catalogue; GET /api/admin/puja/catalogue/export; POST /api/admin/puja/catalogue/merge; GET /api/admin/puja/festivals
2. Call, signed out: GET /api/shops/{id}/puja; POST /api/shops/{id}/puja/seed; POST /api/shops/{id}/puja/types; GET /api/shops/{id}/removed-listings; GET /api/shops/{id}/listing-price-requests; GET and POST /api/listing-price-requests
cases.expected: All 15 calls answer 401; nothing is read or written.

cases.title: Taking the puja catalogue lists every product of the ticked categories at stock 100, priced at MRP, loose items unpriced; unticked categories and products stay out; a second run adds nothing
cases.preconditions: Shop A's owner (a bakery on the test site) signed in; Puja Samagri shop type ON; rule pujaSamagri.seedDefaultStock 100.
cases.steps:
1. GET /api/shops/{A}/puja
2. POST /api/shops/{A}/puja/seed with every category except Kapur (Camphor) and Phool & Patte in excludeCategoryIds, and one not-yet-listed kapur product in excludeProductIds
3. GET /api/shops/{A}/puja/catalogue?categoryId=<Kapur>
4. Check the unticked category Murti, Photos & Yantra
5. POST the same seed again
6. List the loose Phool & Patte items
cases.expected: Setup lists 15 categories totalling at least 499 products. Seed 200 with stock 100. Every newly added kapur item is LISTED at stock 100, priced at its MRP (packed) or with an empty price (loose); the unticked product has no listing; the unticked category has none. The second run adds 0. More than 5 loose flower listings, each unpriced or priced above 0. Puja Samagri is recorded as an added type of the bakery.

cases.title: A removed puja product is listed under Removed, and Restore brings it back with its price and stock
cases.preconditions: Shop A lists a packed kapur product (TC-PUJA-010).
cases.expected: Removal 200 or 204; the listing is in the Removed list; restore 200; the item is LISTED again with the same price and stock (e.g. Bhimseni Kapur – 100 g at ₹520, stock 100).

cases.title: Owner's new product type and product: the duplicate check stops same and close names (closest first); confirming creates them, listed at once, pending review
cases.preconditions: Shop A's owner; category Agarbatti & Dhoop. The names (English, Hindi, Marathi) carry a run suffix so the check can run again on the same site.
cases.steps:
1. POST /api/shops/{A}/puja/types { name: "Agarbatti", unit: "pack" }
2. The same with "Agarbati"
3. POST the type “QA Puja Type <run>” (with Hindi and Marathi names) and confirmDuplicate: true
4. POST /api/shops/{A}/puja/products “Rose Agarbati” with one variant
5. POST the product “QA Puja Dhoop <run>” of that type, variants Small (MRP ₹50, price ₹45, stock 10) and Large (MRP ₹90, price ₹80, stock 10)

cases.title: An e-mail goes out from the first pool mailbox with room and is counted (staging; production read-only)

cases.title: Cap: a mailbox sends up to EMAIL_POOL_DAILY_CAP in 24 hours, then the next one takes over; the main mailbox is last
cases.preconditions: Local server with a test SMTP server; EMAIL_POOL = two mailboxes (box1, box2); AUTH_EMAIL_SERVER = main; EMAIL_POOL_DAILY_CAP=3 (allowed 1–10,000; default 90).
cases.steps:
1. Send 3 e-mails (e.g. sign-in codes)
2. Send a 4th
3. Send e-mails 5–9
4. Send a 10th
cases.expected: E-mails 1–3 go from box1 (3 SENT rows); the 4th from box2 (box1 at the cap is skipped); box2 takes 4–6; 7–9 go from the main mailbox (tried last); the 10th fails as every mailbox is at the cap (TC-NTF-026). With the default cap mailbox 1 sends e-mails 1–90 and the 91st goes from mailbox 2.

cases.title: Rolling 24 hours: sends older than 24 hours no longer count, and there is no midnight reset

cases.steps:
1. Insert 3 SENT rows for box1 dated 25 hours ago and send an e-mail
2. Insert 2 SENT rows for box1 dated 1 hour ago and send another
cases.expected: Step 1 goes from box1 (the old rows are outside the window). Step 2 goes from box2: box1 now has 3 sends in the last 24 hours (step 1's send plus the 2 inserted). Crossing midnight changes nothing.

cases.title: A mailbox the server refuses is paused for an hour; a connection problem moves on without a pause; a bad recipient is not resent
cases.preconditions: Local server and a test SMTP server that can answer per mailbox with a sending-limit refusal (e.g. 550 “daily sending limit exceeded”), a wrong password (535), a dropped connection or a rejected recipient. Clear the REFUSED rows between steps.
cases.steps:
1. Make box1 answer the limit refusal and send
2. Send again within the hour
3. Make box1 answer 535 and send
4. Make box1 drop the connection and send
5. Send to a recipient the server rejects (550 no such user)
6. Read the log and email_mailbox_sends
cases.expected: 1: delivered from box2; box1 gets a REFUSED row with detail “limit: <server reply>” and the log “[email] box1 could not send (limit); trying the next mailbox.” 2: box1 is skipped (paused for an hour). 3: a REFUSED row “auth: …” and box2 sends. 4: box2 sends and box1 gets no REFUSED row (not paused). 5: the send fails once with the recipient error; no other mailbox tries it and no row is written.

cases.title: Every mailbox full: the e-mail fails with a clear log line and goes out once a mailbox frees up

cases.steps:
1. Request a sign-in code
2. Trigger a notification e-mail
3. Read the site log
4. Move one mailbox's oldest send past 24 hours and let the notification retry run
cases.expected: Nothing is sent and no row is written; the log says “[email] All 3 mailboxes have sent 3 e-mails in the last 24 hours (or were refused in the last hour). Add mailboxes to EMAIL_POOL.”; the sign-in code is not sent; the notification delivery fails and is retried as any failed e-mail (TC-NTF-010). After step 4 the retry goes out from the freed mailbox.

cases.title: Without EMAIL_POOL nothing changes; unusable pool entries are skipped with a warning that never shows a password
cases.preconditions: Local server with AUTH_EMAIL_SERVER and AUTH_EMAIL_FROM set.
cases.steps:
1. Unset EMAIL_POOL and send e-mails
2. Set EMAIL_POOL = "code1@gokesari.com" without EMAIL_POOL_PASSWORD and send
3. Set EMAIL_POOL = "not-an-address smtps://smtp.example.com:465 code1@gokesari.com code1@gokesari.com" with EMAIL_POOL_PASSWORD and send
4. Read the log
cases.expected: 1: every e-mail goes through AUTH_EMAIL_SERVER with the AUTH_EMAIL_FROM sender; email_mailbox_sends stays empty. 2: “[email] EMAIL_POOL_PASSWORD is not set, so code1@gokesari.com cannot sign in; it is skipped.”; mail goes through the main mailbox only and is not counted. 3: “[email] an EMAIL_POOL entry is neither a mailbox address nor an SMTP URL; it is skipped.” and “[email] an EMAIL_POOL entry is an SMTP URL with no mailbox name; it is skipped.”; code1 is used once (duplicates and the main address dropped), then the main mailbox. No password appears in any log line.

cases.title: Send counts older than two days are cleaned up — per the code only by the per-job cron route, not by the hourly run
cases.preconditions: CRON_SECRET; rows in email_mailbox_sends older and newer than 48 hours; database access; local server for step 3.
cases.steps:
1. POST /api/cron/hourly with “Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>” (as the server's timer does)
2. Count rows older than 48 hours
3. With CRON_ROUTES_ENABLED=true, POST /api/cron/auth-housekeeping with the same header
4. Count again
5. Call /api/cron/auth-housekeeping with CRON_ROUTES_ENABLED=true but no secret; then with the secret while CRON_ROUTES_ENABLED is not true
cases.expected: Per the code the hourly job “auth-housekeeping” purges only sign-in codes and session revocations, so rows older than 48 hours are still there after step 1 (PR #451 says they are deleted hourly — see code_check). Step 3 answers 200 { otps, sessions, mailboxSends: { deleted: <n> } } and removes exactly the rows older than 48 hours; newer rows stay. Step 5: 401 without the secret; 410 “Scheduled endpoints are disabled.” while CRON_ROUTES_ENABLED is not true (checked before the secret).

cases.title: A paid food shop with no FSSAI licence is flagged on the approval card and a plain Approve is refused
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as the staging admin. A pending, paid food shop (e.g. Bakery) at stage Verified with no valid FSSAI licence on file — e.g. a signup-wizard food shop held for FSSAI before 22-Nov-2026. Rule documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood ON (default).
cases.steps:
1. Open Admin → Shops → Approvals (/admin/console/shops)
2. Find the shop's card and read its badges and notes
3. Click Approve
cases.expected: The card shows the badge “FSSAI licence missing” (“FSSAI licence expired” when the only licence on file has expired) and “FSSAI: no valid licence on file. Upload the copy the owner sent you, or use Approve without documents — the owner then has 30 days to upload it.”, with the link “Upload FSSAI for owner →” and the button “Approve without documents”. (A shop still in KYC pending shows Approve disabled — “Only a verified shop can be approved” — while statusModels.enforceTransitions is on.) Approve is refused (POST /api/shops/<id>/approve → 409) with “A shop that sells food needs a valid FSSAI licence or registration before registration can be completed. Upload it on My Shop → Upload documents.” The shop stays pending; a signup-wizard food shop no longer gets a 90-day FSSAI grace.

cases.title: Approve without documents: the food shop goes live with 30 days to upload its FSSAI licence
cases.preconditions: The shop of TC-DOC-001; the owner's mailbox reachable (staging mail goes to the testing inbox). Rule documentUpload.fssaiWaiverDays = 30 (default).
cases.steps:
1. On the shop's card click “Approve without documents”
2. Read the confirmation text
3. Type the reason “Owner sent the licence by e-mail; uploading it”
4. Click “Confirm approval”
5. Check shop_fssai_waivers, the FSSAI row of shop_legal_documents and the Audit log
6. Check the owner's notifications and mailbox
cases.expected: Step 2: “Approve <shop> as Green without verified documents (… FSSAI licence). The shop goes live now; your name and reason are recorded. The registration fee is still checked. The owner must upload a valid FSSAI licence within 30 days (by <today + 30 days>); they are reminded on the 1st and 15th, and the shop is suspended automatically if it is still missing then.” After Confirm the shop is APPROVED. One shop_fssai_waivers row (reason, waived_by = the admin, due_at = now + 30 days); the FSSAI row in shop_legal_documents gets grace_until = the same date; audit “shop.approved_without_fssai” with the reason, dueAt and days 30. The owner gets “Your shop is approved” and “Upload your licence within 30 days — <shop>”: “FSSAI licence is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 30 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended. Please upload it on GoKesari by <due date>. We will remind you every 15 days until then.” (link /shop/documents?shop=<id>).

cases.title: An operator cannot approve a shop without its FSSAI licence or its documents
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging operator (full operator). The shop of TC-DOC-001, still pending.
cases.expected: The card shows “FSSAI licence missing” and “FSSAI: no valid licence on file. Upload the copy the owner sent you.” with “Upload FSSAI for owner →”, but no “Approve without documents” button. Step 2 → 403 “Only an admin can approve a shop without its must-have documents.”; step 3 → 403 “Only an admin can approve a shop without its documents.” No shop_fssai_waivers row; the shop stays pending.

cases.title: The reason for approving without documents needs 10 to 500 characters
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; a shop held for FSSAI (TC-DOC-001).
cases.steps:
1. Open “Approve without documents” on the card
2. Type a 9-character reason, then add spaces at both ends
3. Type a 10-character reason
4. Send POST /api/shops/<id>/approve with waiveFssai.reason of 9 characters, then of 501 characters
cases.expected: “Confirm approval” stays disabled until the trimmed reason has 10 characters (spaces at the ends do not count) and is enabled at 10. The API answers 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.” for 9 and for 501 characters and approves nothing; 10 to 500 characters are accepted.

cases.title: No FSSAI waiver is recorded for a shop whose valid licence is on file
cases.preconditions: A pending, paid food shop with a valid FSSAI licence on file (verified, or submitted with an expiry date in the future).
cases.steps:
1. Open the shop's card on /admin/console/shops
2. Approve it through the API with waiveFssai and a 10+ character reason
cases.expected: No “FSSAI licence missing” badge or FSSAI note on the card. The approval goes through; no shop_fssai_waivers row and no “shop.approved_without_fssai” audit row are written, and the owner gets no 30-day licence notice.

cases.title: A must-have document set by the admin holds approval; Approve without documents covers it
cases.preconditions: Admin → Shops → Document rules: add Trade licence (municipal) — All shops — Must-have before go-live (remove after). A pending, paid General Trading Store at stage Verified, without a trade licence, that paid before the rule was added (e.g. a signup-wizard shop held by the duplicate check).
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/console/shops and read the shop's card
2. Click Approve
3. Click “Approve without documents”, type a 10+ character reason and click “Confirm approval”
4. Check shop_fssai_waivers, shop_legal_documents and the owner's notices
cases.expected: Card: badge “Trade licence (municipal) missing” and “Must-have for this shop type: Trade licence (municipal) not uploaded. Upload the copy the owner sent you, or use Approve without documents — the owner then has 30 days to upload it.” Approve → 409 “This shop needs its Trade licence (municipal) uploaded before it can go live. An admin can still approve it with "Approve without documents".” The confirmation says the owner must upload Trade licence (municipal) within 30 days (by <date>). After Confirm the shop is live; one shop_fssai_waivers row due in 30 days and no FSSAI row in shop_legal_documents (not a food shop). The owner's 30-day notice currently names the FSSAI licence (see code_check).

cases.title: The upload window after a waiver is the setting documentUpload.fssaiWaiverDays (7 to 180)
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; a food shop held for FSSAI on the approval page.
cases.steps:
1. Admin → Business rules → documentUpload: set fssaiWaiverDays to 6, then 181, and press Save each time
2. Set it to 45 and Save
3. Open “Approve without documents” on the held food shop
4. Restore 30
cases.expected: 6 and 181 are refused (the API answers 422 “That value is not allowed for this setting.”); 45 is saved (“Saved.”). The card then reads “… the owner then has 45 days to upload it.” and the confirmation “… within 45 days (by <today + 45 days>) …”.

cases.title: An admin uploads the FSSAI licence the owner sent, and the shop is then approved normally
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin. A pending, paid food shop held for FSSAI (TC-DOC-001). A test FSSAI certificate (PDF or photo under 5 MB) with the Cashfree sandbox number 10121002000677 and an expiry date in the future.
cases.steps:
1. On the shop's card click “Upload FSSAI for owner →”
2. Read the page
3. On the FSSAI card click “Upload file” and choose the certificate
4. Check the details read from it, tick the consent and click “Verify & Approve”
5. Click “← Shop approvals” and click Approve on the shop
cases.expected: Page /admin/shops/<id>/documents titled “Upload documents for <shop>” with “For a document <owner> sent to GoKesari (by e-mail, WhatsApp or by hand). … It goes through the same checks as the owner's own upload, and your name is recorded with it.”, a “Still needed” list naming FSSAI licence / registration, and “FSSAI licence required — This shop sells food, so a valid FSSAI licence or registration is needed. An expired licence is not accepted.” The consent line reads “<owner> sent this document to GoKesari and agreed to it being checked. On their behalf: …”. After Verify & Approve the FSSAI card is done; the upload is confirmed under the admin (seller_document_uploads.confirmed_by = the admin; audit “seller_document.upload_confirmed” by the admin). Approve then succeeds with no waiver.

cases.title: A full operator reaches Upload for owner from the approval card and from Shops missing documents
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging operator (full). A pending food shop held for FSSAI, a pending non-food shop in KYC pending, and a live shop listed on Shops missing documents.
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/console/shops and read the links on both pending cards
2. Open Shops missing documents (/admin/shops/missing-documents)
3. Click “Upload for owner →” on a live shop and upload a Shop Act certificate for it with Verify & Approve
cases.expected: Food shop card: “Upload FSSAI for owner →”; non-food shop in KYC pending: “Upload documents for owner →”; both open /admin/shops/<id>/documents. Each row of Shops missing documents has “Open shop →” and “Upload for owner →”. The operator can upload and Verify & Approve like an admin; the upload is recorded under the operator.

cases.title: Only admins and full operators can open Upload documents for a shop
cases.preconditions: A shop id from the staging test world not owned by the testers below. Staging customer, shop owner and operator-limited test accounts.
cases.steps:
1. Signed out, open /admin/shops/<id>/documents
2. As the customer, a shop owner (of another shop) and the operator-limited account, open the same page
3. As that shop owner call GET /api/shops/<id>/documents and POST /api/shops/<id>/documents/read for the other shop
4. Signed out, call GET /api/shops/<id>/documents
5. As admin open /admin/shops/not-a-uuid/documents
cases.expected: Step 1: redirected to /signin?callbackUrl=/admin/shops/<id>/documents. Step 2: each is sent away (to /admin, which sends anyone not admin or operator to the home page); the upload panel never shows. Step 3: 403 “This shop does not belong to you.”; nothing is read or stored. Step 4: 401 “Please sign in to continue.” Step 5: the 404 page.

cases.title: A licence or Shop Act file over 5 MB is refused when it is uploaded
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a shop owner with a registered shop. Test files: a 6 MB PDF, a 4.9 MB PDF, an 11 MB photo (test documents only). Rules uploads.sellerDocumentMaxBytes = 5 000 000 and documentUpload.maxUploadBytes = 10 000 000 (defaults).
cases.steps:
1. Open My Shop → Upload documents (/shop/documents)
2. On the FSSAI, Shop Act or a licence card upload the 6 MB PDF
3. Upload the 4.9 MB PDF on the same card
4. On the PAN or GSTIN card (where shown) upload a 6 MB PDF
5. On any card upload the 11 MB photo
cases.expected: Step 2 is refused at once, before any field is shown: “This document can be at most 5 MB. Upload a smaller PDF, or take a photo of it instead.” Step 3 is read and its fields shown. Step 4 is accepted (only licences and the Shop Act are kept in the 5 MB registers). Step 5: “The file can be at most 10 MB. Take the photo again at a lower size or upload a smaller PDF.” Verify & Approve never fails half-way because of size.

cases.title: Shop verification and the FSSAI reminders point to Upload documents for a licence copy
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a shop owner with a registered shop; an FSSAI reminder or 30-day FSSAI notice in the app (TC-DOC-002 / TC-DOC-030).
cases.steps:
1. Open Shop verification (/shop/verification)
2. Click the upload link
3. Open the FSSAI notice in the app and follow its link
cases.expected: Shop verification shows “Have a licence certificate to send — FSSAI, drug licence, trade licence or any other? Upload a photo or PDF on Upload documents →”, opening /shop/documents?shop=<id>. FSSAI reminders and the FSSAI waiver notice open /shop/documents?shop=<id>, not the numbers-only verification page; a reminder about licences only opens /shop/legal-documents.

cases.title: Upload documents for a shop shows the waiver date, what is still needed, the complete and switched-off states, and works on a phone
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin. A shop approved without its FSSAI licence (TC-DOC-002) and a shop with every required document on file. Developer help for step 3 (staging only).
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/shops/<waived shop>/documents
2. Open the page for the complete shop
3. With the developer switch Business rules → documentUpload.enabled off, reopen, then restore
4. Repeat step 1 at 375 px width
cases.expected: Step 1: warning “Approved without its FSSAI licence — The FSSAI licence is due by <due date>. The shop is suspended automatically if a valid licence is still not on file then.” and “Still needed” listing the missing documents. Step 2: “All required documents are uploaded.” Step 3: “Document upload is switched off — Turn on Business rules → documentUpload to upload documents here.” and no upload panel. Phone: no sideways scroll; every card and the Verify & Approve button are reachable.

cases.title: An FSSAI licence is checked online with Cashfree (sandbox numbers on staging)
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as the owner of a test food shop (name and PIN set). Rule sellerVerification.fssaiProvider = cashfree (default); CASHFREE_VERIFICATION_CLIENT_ID and _CLIENT_SECRET set on staging with CASHFREE_VERIFICATION_ENV (or CASHFREE_ENV) = sandbox — otherwise see TC-DOC-016. Cashfree sandbox numbers only: 10121002000677 (valid licence), 20121002000678 (valid registration).
cases.steps:
1. Open Shop verification (/shop/verification)
2. On the FSSAI card enter 10121002000677, tick the consent and click Verify
3. Read the status and the reason
4. Repeat with 20121002000678 on another test food shop
5. Read the shop's FSSAI row in seller_verifications
cases.expected: The check goes to Cashfree, not Sandbox.co.in (seller_verifications.provider_id = cashfree) and is never “This document can't be checked online”. Cashfree gives no expiry date: a licence it reports active counts as in force. The card shows “Verified” only when the business name on the record matches the shop or owner name (score at least sellerVerification.nameMatchAutoApprove, 85) and the record's PIN code is the shop's; otherwise “Under review” with “The name on the record doesn't clearly match your name or business name. Our team will check it.” or “The address on the record is at a different PIN code from your shop. Our team will check it.” — the expected outcome for sandbox numbers whose record is not the test shop's. The registration number behaves the same.

cases.title: An FSSAI number Cashfree does not know is refused with its own message
cases.preconditions: As TC-DOC-014; the Cashfree sandbox number 99121002000679 (invalid).
cases.steps:
1. On Shop verification enter 99121002000679 on the FSSAI card, tick the consent and click Verify
2. Read the card
3. Enter 1234567890123 (13 digits) and click Verify
cases.expected: Step 2: “Not verified” with “This number wasn't found in the government record. Check it and submit again.”; the owner can submit a corrected number. Step 3 is refused before any Cashfree call: “An FSSAI licence or registration number is exactly 14 digits.”

cases.title: Without the Cashfree keys, or with fssaiProvider = kyc_provider, FSSAI goes to manual review as before
cases.preconditions: On staging only, with the developer: either the Cashfree Verification keys not set, or Admin → Business rules → sellerVerification.fssaiProvider = kyc_provider (restore cashfree after).
cases.steps:
1. As a shop owner submit a 14-digit FSSAI number on Shop verification
2. As admin open Seller verification review (/admin/seller-verification)
cases.expected: The card shows “Under review” with “This document can't be checked online. Our team will review it.” (never “Not verified”); the review queue lists it with Approve, Ask for more info and Reject. PAN and GSTIN checks are unchanged (Sandbox.co.in).

cases.title: Cashfree-verified FSSAI licences are re-checked every 7 days and a lapsed one is caught
cases.preconditions: A shop with an FSSAI licence VERIFIED by Cashfree (provider_id = cashfree). Developer access to the staging database and the daily seller-verification sweep.
cases.steps:
1. Move the row's last_attempt_at 8 days back
2. Run the daily seller-verification sweep
3. Read the sweep result and the row
cases.expected: The sweep counts the licence under fssaiRechecked and asks Cashfree again (rule sellerVerification.fssaiRecheckDays, 7); a licence checked less than 7 days ago, or verified by another provider, is not re-checked. If Cashfree now reports the licence not in force (license_active_flag false) the row becomes FAILED with “The government record shows this document as inactive.” and is handled like any lapsed document.

cases.title: FSSAI provider and re-check settings accept only their allowed values
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin.
cases.steps:
1. Admin → Business rules → sellerVerification: set fssaiProvider to gridlines and press Save
2. Set fssaiRecheckDays to 0, then 366, and Save each time
3. Set fssaiRecheckDays to 1, then 365, and Save; restore cashfree and 7
cases.expected: Steps 1 and 2 are refused (422 “That value is not allowed for this setting.”); only cashfree or kyc_provider and 1–365 days are saved (“Saved.”).

cases.title: A sandbox Cashfree answer never verifies a licence on gokesari.com, and the test site never calls production
cases.preconditions: Configuration review with the developer; no FSSAI check on production with test data.
cases.steps:
1. Read which value CASHFREE_VERIFICATION_ENV / CASHFREE_ENV has on gokesari.com and on test.gokesari.com (names and modes only, never keys)
2. On staging only, with the developer, set CASHFREE_VERIFICATION_ENV=production for a moment, submit an FSSAI number, then restore
cases.expected: Production runs production and staging runs sandbox. With a mismatch no check is sent: the card shows “Checking” with “Verification is paused on our side. We'll check this as soon as it's back.”; the server log names the variable, never a key or the licence number.

cases.title: A food shop cannot leave the documents screen without its FSSAI licence
cases.preconditions: Signed in on test.gokesari.com as a new test user with no shop. A GSTIN that the staging KYC provider verifies (agreed with the owner; never a real person's number) and a valid referral code. Shop type Bakery. Rule documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood ON (default).
cases.steps:
1. Complete Verify, the address, the map pin and “Contact and shop details” with shop type Bakery
2. On “Payment” click “Create my shop and pay”
3. Read “Upload your documents”
4. Try “Continue to payment” without uploading anything
5. Send POST /api/shops/registration-draft/documents-step with {promise: true}
cases.expected: After “Create my shop and pay” the wizard shows “Upload your documents” (“Add your FSSAI licence, Shop Act certificate, Udyam and any other licence — a photo or PDF, read for you. A valid PAN or GST is already checked.”), not the payment. Warning “FSSAI licence required — Your shop sells food, so an FSSAI licence or registration is required by law. Please upload it below to continue — your shop goes live only once it is on file.” The FSSAI card is required, no promise box is offered while FSSAI is missing, “Continue to payment” is disabled and there is no “Upload later” button. The API answers 409 “Your shop sells food, so an FSSAI licence is required by law. Please upload your FSSAI licence to continue.” (reason FSSAI_REQUIRED).

cases.title: The fee checkout refuses a food shop without its FSSAI licence
cases.preconditions: The new Bakery shop of TC-DOC-020 at “Upload your documents”, no FSSAI uploaded.
cases.steps:
1. From the owner's session send POST /api/shops/<shop id>/registration-fee
2. Open Manage → Registration and fee (/shop/registration-fee)
3. Check the shop's status and payment intents
cases.expected: Step 1 → 409 “Your shop sells food, so an FSSAI licence is required by law. Please upload your FSSAI licence before paying the registration fee.” (reason FSSAI_REQUIRED); no payment intent is created and no money can be taken. Step 2 sends the owner back to /shop/register (the documents screen). The shop stays PENDING_APPROVAL.

cases.title: With its FSSAI licence uploaded, the food shop promises the rest, pays and goes live
cases.preconditions: As TC-DOC-020; a test FSSAI certificate (sandbox number 10121002000677, expiry in the future, under 5 MB). Pay on the built-in page “Pay (success)” while PAYMENT_GATEWAY=SANDBOX, or with Cashfree sandbox UPI testsuccess@gocash.
cases.steps:
1. On the FSSAI card upload the certificate, check the details, tick the consent and click “Verify & Approve”
2. Read the screen
3. Tick “I will upload Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate within 90 days …” and click “Continue to payment”
4. Pay the fee
5. Check the shop row and the owner's mailbox
cases.expected: After Verify & Approve the FSSAI warning disappears and the promise box shows “Not uploaded yet: Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate. …”. Continue opens “Pay the registration fee”. After payment the shop is live (APPROVED), documents_due_at = the promise + 90 days. The owner gets the go-live e-mail but no “Upload your licence within … days” e-mail for FSSAI.

cases.title: A non-food shop goes on to payment only with the Shop Act uploaded or promised
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a new test user; a staging-verifiable GSTIN; shop type General Trading Store; the Shop Act not uploaded. Rule shopDocumentFollowUp.promiseDays = 90 (default); the Shop Act rule as seeded (All shops — on the promise).
cases.steps:
1. Reach “Upload your documents” after “Create my shop and pay”
2. Read the promise box
3. Send POST /api/shops/registration-draft/documents-step with no body
4. Send POST /api/shops/<id>/registration-fee
5. Tick the promise and click “Continue to payment”
6. Check the shop row and the Audit log
cases.expected: Box: “Not uploaded yet: Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate. Your shop can go live without it if you promise to upload it later.” and the tick “I will upload Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate within 90 days (by <today + 90 days>). I understand GoKesari will remind me by e-mail and my shop will be suspended if it is not uploaded by then.”; “Continue to payment” is disabled until it is ticked. Step 3 → 409 “Please upload Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate, or tick that you will upload it within 90 days.” (reason DOCUMENTS_PROMISE_NEEDED). Step 4 → 409 “Please upload Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate, or confirm that you will upload it within 90 days, before paying the registration fee.” After the tick the payment opens; documents_promised_at = now, documents_due_at = now + 90 days; audit “shop.documents_promised” with source SIGNUP_WIZARD and the missing list.

cases.title: Uploading the Shop Act on the documents screen removes the need for a promise
cases.preconditions: As TC-DOC-023; a test Shop Act certificate (under 5 MB).
cases.steps:
1. At “Upload your documents” upload the Shop Act certificate on its card and click “Verify & Approve”
2. Read the screen
3. Click “Continue to payment”
cases.expected: Once the Shop Act is sent (verified or waiting for GoKesari's check) the promise box disappears and “Continue to payment” is enabled at once; no promise is recorded (documents_promised_at stays empty) and the payment opens.

cases.title: A pharmacy promises its Shop Act and drug licence and goes live on payment
cases.preconditions: Signed in as a new test user; a staging-verifiable GSTIN or PAN; shop type Pharmacy / Medical Store. Sandbox payment as in TC-DOC-022.
cases.steps:
1. Pick Pharmacy / Medical Store on “Contact and shop details” and read the notice
2. Create the shop and read “Upload your documents”
3. Tick the promise and pay
4. Open Legal documents (/shop/legal-documents)
cases.expected: Notice: “Drug licence is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.” Documents screen: no warning; “Not uploaded yet: Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate, Drug licence. Your shop can go live without them if you promise to upload them later.” and the tick ends “… if they are not uploaded by then.” After payment the shop is live. Legal documents shows the Drug licence card with “Required”, “Not uploaded” and an “Upload by <date>” note; the shop keeps taking orders.

cases.title: With documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood off, FSSAI becomes a promised document
cases.preconditions: On staging only: Admin → Business rules → documentUpload.fssaiMandatoryForFood set to false (restore true right after). A new test user; shop type Dairy Shop.
cases.steps:
1. Pick Dairy Shop on “Contact and shop details” and read the notice
2. Create the shop and read “Upload your documents”
3. Tick the promise and pay
4. Restore the switch
cases.expected: Notice: “FSSAI licence is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.” No “FSSAI licence required” warning; the promise covers “Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate, FSSAI licence”. The shop pays and goes live without FSSAI (approval does not wait for it); the follow-up then chases it like any promised document.

cases.title: The documents screen is asked once; after the promise the owner returns straight to payment
cases.preconditions: A new General Trading Store registration that gave the promise (TC-DOC-023) but did not pay.
cases.steps:
1. Close the payment without paying
2. Reopen /shop/register
3. As admin add a must-have rule for General Trading Store (e.g. Fire NOC), reopen /shop/register as the owner, then remove the rule
cases.expected: Step 2: the wizard opens on “Pay the registration fee”; the documents screen is not asked again and no “Upload later” button exists. Step 3: the documents screen comes back with “Required before you pay” and the line “You promised to upload your remaining documents by <date>. We will remind you by e-mail on the 1st and 15th of each month; if they are still missing on that date, your shop will be suspended.”

cases.title: The documents screen works on a phone
cases.preconditions: A phone (or a 375 × 812 viewport) and a new test user at “Upload your documents” for a food shop; a test FSSAI certificate.
cases.steps:
1. Read the screen top to bottom
2. Upload a photo of the FSSAI certificate from the phone's camera on its card and Verify & Approve
3. Tick the promise and tap “Continue to payment”
cases.expected: No sideways scroll; the warning, every card, the promise checkbox with its text and the button are readable and tappable; the photo is read and its fields filled; the payment opens after the tick.

cases.title: The documents-step API checks sign-in, the body and the registration
cases.preconditions: A staging customer account with no registration in progress.
cases.expected: 1 → 401 “Please sign in to continue.” 2 → 404 “Registration in progress was not found.” 3 → 422 “Request body must be valid JSON.” 4 → 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.” (promise must be true or false; no other keys). An empty body is treated as no promise.

cases.title: A food shop approved without FSSAI is reminded until its due date, then suspended automatically
cases.preconditions: A food shop approved with “Approve without documents” (TC-DOC-002), its Shop Act already verified, no FSSAI uploaded. The follow-up runs in the 05.00 IST daily cron on the reminder days (shopDocumentFollowUp.reminderDaysOfMonth: 1st and 15th). On staging only, with the developer: trigger the run on a reminder day, then move shop_fssai_waivers.due_at into the past (restore after).
cases.steps:
1. Trigger the follow-up on a reminder day before the due date
2. Read the owner's reminder
3. Move the waiver's due date into the past and trigger the next reminder-day run
4. Open the shop in Seller Central, the admin / operator notifications and the public shop page
cases.expected: Reminder (e-mail and in-app) “Submit your shop documents — reminder 1”: “<shop> is live, but these documents are still missing: FSSAI licence / registration. Your shop went live before its documents; they are due by <due date>. Upload them on GoKesari so we can verify them. If they are still missing on <due date>, your shop will be suspended automatically. We will remind you every 15 days until then.” (link /shop/documents?shop=<id>). After the due date the run suspends the shop: “Reason: FSSAI licence not uploaded by <due date>, the date set when the shop was approved without it. Missing: FSSAI licence / registration.” and “What to do: Upload FSSAI licence / registration on GoKesari (Shop → Verification). Our team reinstates the shop once they are verified.” Admins and operators get “Shop suspended for missing documents: <shop>”. Public page: “This shop is suspended and is not taking orders.”

cases.title: A shop that uploads its FSSAI licence before the due date is not suspended on that date
cases.preconditions: As TC-DOC-030, before the due date; a valid FSSAI certificate (expiry in the future).
cases.steps:
1. As the owner upload the FSSAI licence on Upload documents and Verify & Approve
2. With the developer move the waiver's due date into the past and trigger a reminder-day run
cases.expected: The shop stays live (APPROVED); once a valid licence is on file the FSSAI due date no longer applies and no FSSAI reminder is sent. Any other missing document follows its own date.

cases.title: A PAN-only wizard shop is chased only for the Shop Act it promised, then suspended after the date
cases.preconditions: A wizard shop registered with a verified PAN and the “not GST-registered” declaration (no GSTIN), live on the promise without its Shop Act. Staging only, with the developer, for triggering runs and moving dates.
cases.steps:
1. Trigger the follow-up on a reminder day
2. Read the reminder
3. With the developer move approved_at, documents_promised_at and documents_due_at more than 90 days back and trigger the next reminder-day run
4. Read the suspension notice
cases.expected: The reminder names only “Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate” (never the GSTIN) and says “You promised to upload them when you registered your shop; they are due by <date>.” After the date the shop is suspended with “Reason: Shop documents promised at registration not uploaded by <date>: Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate.”

cases.title: A document made needed after a shop went live is reminded until the rule's date, not suspended before it
cases.preconditions: A live General Trading Store shop registered outside the signup wizard, with no documents promise or waiver, its GSTIN and Shop Act verified (not on Shops missing documents). Admin → Shops → Document rules: add Fire NOC — General Trading Store — “Upload later, on the owner's promise”, “Live shops get (days)” 60 (remove after). Developer help to trigger runs and move the rule date (staging only).
cases.steps:
1. Open Shops missing documents
2. Trigger the follow-up on a reminder day and read the owner's reminder
3. With the developer move the rule's live_shops_due_at into the past and trigger reminder-day runs until the shop has had 3 reminders
cases.expected: The shop appears with the badge “Fire NOC due <today + 60 days>”. Reminder: “<shop> is live, but these documents are still missing: Fire NOC (by <date>). GoKesari now needs this document from shops like yours, as the law requires. Please upload it by <date>. Upload them on GoKesari so we can verify them. If it is still missing on <date>, your shop will be suspended automatically. We will remind you every 15 days until then.” (link /shop/legal-documents). It is never suspended before the date; after it (with 3 reminders sent, shopDocumentFollowUp.remindersBeforeSuspension) the run suspends it with “Reason: Shop documents needed for this type of shop not uploaded by <date>: Fire NOC.”

cases.title: Optional documents are never chased; a pharmacy registered before the wizard is now chased for its licence
cases.preconditions: A live General Trading Store shop missing only its Shop Act; a live Pharmacy / Medical Store registered outside the wizard, missing its drug licence.
cases.steps:
1. Open Shops missing documents (Live)
2. In Document rules set Shop Act — All shops to Optional
3. Reopen Shops missing documents and trigger a reminder-day run
4. Restore Shop Act — All shops to “Upload later, on the owner's promise”
cases.expected: Before: the general store shows “Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate missing”. With the Shop Act optional it leaves the list and gets no reminder. The pharmacy shows “Drug licence due 20 Feb 2027” (the rule's date, 90 days after migration 0163 ran on staging) and is reminded on the 1st / 15th but not suspended for it before that date.

cases.title: Shops missing documents lists licences, rule dates and promises, with Upload for owner
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin, then the operator. Shops in each state of TC-DOC-030 … TC-DOC-034. Developer help for step 4 (staging only).
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/shops/missing-documents
2. Switch between Live, Suspended and Awaiting approval
3. Read a row's badges and links
4. With the developer switch shopDocumentFollowUp.enabled off, reopen, then restore
cases.expected: Header: “Live shops are reminded on day 1 and 15 of each month (next: <date>) and suspended automatically after reminder 3. Documents waiting for our check are not chased.” Rows show “<document> missing”, “<document> waiting for our check”, “<licence> due <date>” for rule dates, “promised by <date>” or “promise overdue since <date>”, “Reminders: n of 3”, “Open shop →” and “Upload for owner →”. With the rule off: “The documents follow-up is switched off (rule shopDocumentFollowUp): no reminders are sent and no shop is suspended.”

cases.title: Document rules page explains the rules and shows today's seeded rules
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; migrations 0163 and 0165 applied and the rules unchanged since.
cases.steps:
1. Open Admin → Shops → More → Document rules (/admin/shop-documents)
2. Read “How it works”
3. Read each document card
cases.expected: Page “Shop documents” — “Which licences and legal documents each kind of shop needs: must-have before going live, upload later on the owner's promise, or optional. Add a document when a law starts requiring it.” How it works: “GST number or PAN — always a must-have for every shop (owner rule DF-08). It is not changed here.”; “Must-have before go-live — The owner cannot pay the registration fee (or go live) until it is uploaded.”; “Upload later, on the owner's promise — The shop may go live once the owner promises to upload it; e-mail reminders, then suspension after the due date.”; “Optional — Shown as an optional upload; never chased.”; the precedence (one shop type, then “Doctors”, then “Shops that sell food”, then “All shops”); and “When you make a document needed, shops already live get the days you give (default 90) … New shops follow the rule at once.” Cards: Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate — All shops — on the promise; Udyam registration — All shops — Optional; FSSAI licence / registration — Shops that sell food — Must-have before go-live; Drug licence — Pharmacy / Medical Store — on the promise; Medical / professional registration — Doctor's Clinic, Doctors (shops in a Health doctor category), Professional office — CA, CS, advocate, tax consultant, Super Speciality Clinic — on the promise; each licence rule with “shops already live: by 20 Feb 2027”. Trade licence (municipal), Weights & measures (legal metrology) certificate, Fire NOC and Seeds / fertiliser / pesticide licence: “Not asked of any shop yet — add a rule below.”

cases.title: Changing a rule's level takes effect at once for new registrations
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; a new test user ready to register a General Trading Store.
cases.steps:
1. On the Shop Act card change “All shops” to Optional
2. As the new test user reach “Upload your documents”
3. As admin set Shop Act — All shops back to “Upload later, on the owner's promise”
cases.expected: Notice “Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate for All shops: optional.” The new shop's documents screen has no promise box, the Shop Act card is optional and “Continue to payment” is enabled at once. Step 3 shows “… for All shops: upload later, on the owner's promise.” and new registrations must again upload or promise the Shop Act.

cases.title: Add a rule for one shop type with the days shops already live get
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; Fire NOC has no rule.
cases.steps:
1. On the Fire NOC card read the defaults of the “Add a rule for” form
2. Choose “Add a rule for”: General Trading Store, “How”: Must-have before go-live, “Live shops get (days)”: 60
3. Click “Add rule”
4. Open “Add a rule for” again
5. Remove the rule after the test (or keep it for TC-DOC-050)
cases.expected: Defaults: How “Upload later, on the owner's promise”, 90 days. Notice “Fire NOC for General Trading Store: must-have before go-live.” The card lists “General Trading Store  shops already live: by <today + 60 days>” with its level selector and “Remove”; General Trading Store is no longer offered in “Add a rule for”.

cases.title: Days for shops already live accept 7 to 365
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin.
cases.steps:
1. In the Fire NOC “Add a rule for” form type 6, then 366 days and click “Add rule”
2. Send PUT /api/admin/shop-document-rules with {docKey: FIRE_NOC, scope: ALL, level: PROMISE, liveShopDays: 6}, then 366
3. Save Fire NOC — All shops with 7 days, and Fire NOC — Shops that sell food with 365 days
4. Choose How = Optional in the form
5. Remove the test rules
cases.expected: The browser refuses 6 and 366 in the number field (min 7, max 365); the API answers 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.” and saves nothing. 7 and 365 are saved (“shops already live: by today + 7 / + 365 days”). With Optional the days field is disabled and no date is shown.

cases.title: The most specific rule wins: shop type, then Doctors, then food shops, then all shops
cases.preconditions: Rules added for the test (removed after): Fire NOC — All shops — on the promise; Fire NOC — Shops that sell food — Must-have before go-live; Fire NOC — Bakery — Optional. New test users for three registrations.
cases.steps:
1. Reach “Upload your documents” for a General Trading Store, a Dairy Shop and a Bakery
2. Read what each asks for the Fire NOC
cases.expected: General Trading Store: Fire NOC in the promise list (all shops). Dairy Shop: Fire NOC required before paying (“Required before you pay — Fire NOC is required by law for your type of shop. Please upload it below to continue.”) next to the FSSAI warning; the API names both (“FSSAI licence and Fire NOC are required by law for your type of shop. Please upload them to continue.”, reason DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED). Bakery: Fire NOC only offered as optional, never in the promise and never blocking.

cases.title: Remove a rule: the document falls back to a broader rule or is no longer asked
cases.preconditions: Fire NOC rules for All shops and for Bakery (TC-DOC-040).
cases.steps:
1. Click “Remove” on the Bakery rule and read the confirmation
2. Confirm
3. Remove the All shops rule
cases.expected: Confirmation “Remove the rule "Fire NOC — Bakery"? Those shops will no longer be asked for it (unless a broader rule applies).” Notice “Rule removed: Fire NOC — Bakery.”; bakeries now follow the All shops rule. After the last removal the card reads “Not asked of any shop yet — add a rule below.”

cases.title: Raising a document keeps or restarts the live-shop date as designed, and every change is audited
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; Fire NOC has no rule.
cases.steps:
1. Add Fire NOC — All shops — on the promise, 60 days
2. Change it to Must-have before go-live
3. Change it to Optional, then back to on the promise
4. Remove it
5. Open the Audit log filtered on shop_document_rule
cases.expected: Step 2 keeps “shops already live: by <today + 60 days>”; step 3 (Optional, then on the promise) gives a new date of today + 90 days (the default days). Audit rows “shop_document_rule.saved” for each change (document, scope, previous and new level and date, the admin) and “shop_document_rule.removed” for the removal.

cases.title: Only an admin changes document rules; operators only read them
cases.preconditions: Staging operator, customer and shop owner test accounts; a rule id and an added-document key from the page.
cases.steps:
1. As the operator open /admin/shop-documents
2. As the operator send PUT /api/admin/shop-document-rules, POST /api/admin/shop-document-types, PATCH /api/admin/shop-document-types/<key> and DELETE /api/admin/shop-document-rules/<id>
3. As the customer and the shop owner open /admin/shop-documents and call GET /api/admin/shop-document-rules
4. Signed out, repeat step 3
cases.expected: Operator: the page shows “Only an admin can change these rules.”, levels as badges and no selects, Remove, Add rule, Edit document, Switch off or Add a document; GET works and each write answers 403 “You do not have access to this area.” and changes nothing. Customer / shop owner: sent to the home page; the API answers 403. Guest: redirected to /signin; the API answers 401 “Please sign in to continue.”

cases.title: The rule API refuses unknown documents, scopes and shop types
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin.
cases.steps:
1. PUT /api/admin/shop-document-rules with docKey NOT_A_DOC
2. With scope everyone
3. With scope TYPE:NO_SUCH_TYPE
4. With a 301-character note
5. DELETE /api/admin/shop-document-rules/not-a-uuid
cases.expected: 1 → 404 “Document was not found.” 2 → 422 “Choose who the rule applies to.” 3 → 422 “Unknown shop type.” 4 → 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.” 5 → 422 “Unknown rule.” Nothing is saved.

cases.title: Document rules page on a phone
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin on a phone or a 375 px viewport.
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/shop-documents
2. Change a level and add a rule (remove it after)
3. Open “Add a document”
cases.expected: No sideways scroll; each card's rules, selectors, the stacked “Add rule” form and the add-document form are readable and usable; notices appear under “How it works”.

cases.title: Add a document the law newly requires
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; no document named Pollution control NOC yet.
cases.steps:
1. Click “Add a document”
2. Enter Name of the document “Pollution control NOC”, Which law “State Pollution Control Board consent to operate”, Hindi and Marathi names empty; untick “Number on the document”, leave “Expiry date” unticked, tick “Issuing authority”
3. Click “Add document”
4. Check the Audit log
cases.expected: Notice “Pollution control NOC added. Now add a rule: which shops need it, and how.” A card “Pollution control NOC” with the law note, “Asks for: issuing authority, a copy”, the badge “Added by admin” and “Not asked of any shop yet — add a rule below.” Stored under key DOC:POLLUTION-CONTROL-NOC; audit “shop_document_type.added”. No shop is asked for it until a rule is added.

cases.title: Names and law notes of added documents are checked
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; Pollution control NOC already added (TC-DOC-046).
cases.steps:
1. Try the names “NO”, “Licence #5” and an 81-character name
2. Try the name “Fire NOC”
3. Add “pollution control noc” again
4. Give a 4-character law note
5. POST /api/admin/shop-document-types without lawNote
cases.expected: “Add document” stays disabled for a name under 3 or a law note under 5 characters. The API refuses: a bad or long name 422 “Name the document in 3–80 characters: letters, digits, spaces and & / ( ) . , ' -”; “Fire NOC” 409 “Fire NOC is already in the list. Change its rules instead.”; the repeat 409 “A document named pollution control noc is already in the list.”; the short law note 422 “Say which law (or why) the document is needed, in 5–300 characters.”; the missing field 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.”

cases.title: An added document on the promise: promised at signup and uploaded on its own form
cases.preconditions: Pollution control NOC added (TC-DOC-046) with the rule General Trading Store — on the promise. A new test user registering a General Trading Store; a test PDF.
cases.steps:
1. Reach “Upload your documents”
2. Read “More documents for your type of shop” and the promise box
3. On the Pollution control NOC card upload the PDF without an authority
4. Enter the issuing authority “MPCB Pune” and upload again
5. After going live open Legal documents; as admin open Admin → Shops → More → Legal documents
cases.expected: The card shows the law note, the badge “Required” and “Not uploaded”; the number is optional (“If the document has a number”). The promise lists “Shop Act (Shops & Establishments) certificate, Pollution control NOC”. Without the authority: “Enter the authority that issued the licence (3–120 characters).” With it the card shows “Submitted — under review” and the promise list drops it. It shows on /shop/legal-documents and in the legal-documents review queue.

cases.title: Edit, switch off and switch on an added document: no longer asked, uploads kept
cases.preconditions: Pollution control NOC with a rule and one shop's upload (TC-DOC-048).
cases.steps:
1. Click “Edit document”, change the law note and Save
2. Click “Switch off” and confirm
3. Send PUT /api/admin/shop-document-rules for it
4. As a new General Trading Store registration reach the documents screen
5. Click “Switch on”
cases.expected: Step 1: “Pollution control NOC saved.”; the key stays DOC:POLLUTION-CONTROL-NOC. Step 2: “Switch off Pollution control NOC? No shop will be asked for it any more; what shops uploaded is kept.”, then the badge “Switched off” and no rule controls. Step 3 → 409 “Pollution control NOC is switched off. Switch it on before giving it rules.” New registrations are not asked for it; the file already uploaded stays on record. After “Switch on” its rules apply again. Audit “shop_document_type.updated” for each change.

cases.title: A must-have document set by the admin must be uploaded before paying
cases.preconditions: Rule Fire NOC — General Trading Store — Must-have before go-live (TC-DOC-038; remove after). A new test user registering a General Trading Store; a test Fire NOC PDF.
cases.steps:
1. Reach “Upload your documents”
2. Send POST /api/shops/registration-draft/documents-step with {promise: true}
3. Send POST /api/shops/<id>/registration-fee
4. Upload the Fire NOC (number and copy) and tick the promise for the Shop Act
5. Continue to payment and pay
cases.expected: Warning “Required before you pay — Fire NOC is required by law for your type of shop. Please upload it below to continue.”; the Fire NOC card is required; “Continue to payment” is disabled and no promise box shows. Step 2 → 409 “Fire NOC is required by law for your type of shop. Please upload it to continue.” (reason DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED, missing [Fire NOC]); step 3 → 409 “Fire NOC is required by law for your type of shop. Please upload it before paying the registration fee.” After the upload the promise box appears, then the payment; the shop goes live.

cases.title: The shop-type notice and the upload checklist follow the admin's rules
cases.preconditions: Rules for the test (remove after): Fire NOC — General Trading Store — Must-have; Trade licence (municipal) — General Trading Store — on the promise. A new test user, and the owner of a live General Trading Store.
cases.steps:
1. On “Contact and shop details” pick General Trading Store and read the notices
2. As the live store's owner open My Shop → Upload documents (/shop/documents)
cases.expected: Notices: “Fire NOC is mandatory for this type of shop. You will upload it before paying the registration fee; your shop goes live once it is on file.” and “Trade licence (municipal) is mandatory for this type of shop. Your shop can go live now, and you have a grace period of 90 days to upload it. Otherwise, your shop will be suspended.”; the Shop Act and Udyam are never shown there. Upload documents: Fire NOC, Trade licence and Shop Act cards marked required, Udyam optional, no FSSAI card (not a food shop); the other licences offered as optional.

cases.title: Migrations 0159, 0163 and 0165 are applied and seeded
cases.preconditions: Read access to the staging database (and later production); the rules not changed by an admin since the release.
cases.steps:
1. Read the migration journal
2. Read shop_fssai_waivers, shop_document_types and shop_document_rules
3. Read the shop_document_rules_scope check
cases.expected: 0159_shop_fssai_waivers, 0163_shop_document_rules and 0165_doctor_document_scope are applied (additive only). shop_document_rules holds FSSAI / FOOD / MUST_HAVE, SHOP_ACT / ALL / PROMISE, UDYAM / ALL / OPTIONAL, DRUG_LICENCE / TYPE:PHARMACY / PROMISE and MEDICAL_REGISTRATION / PROMISE for TYPE:DOCTOR_CLINIC, TYPE:SUPER_SPECIALITY_CLINIC, TYPE:PROFESSIONAL_OFFICE and DOCTOR; the licence rows' live_shops_due_at is 90 days after their migration ran, the others empty. One rule per document and scope; the scope check accepts ALL, FOOD, DOCTOR and TYPE:<KEY>; added-document keys must look like DOC:<NAME>.

cases.title: Document rules offer the Doctors scope, with the medical registration on the promise
cases.preconditions: Signed in as the staging admin; migration 0165 applied.
cases.steps:
1. Open /admin/shop-documents and read the Medical / professional registration card
2. Open “Add a rule for” on the Fire NOC card
cases.expected: A rule “Doctors (shops in a Health doctor category)” — “Upload later, on the owner's promise” — “shops already live: by 20 Feb 2027”, next to the Doctor's Clinic, Super Speciality Clinic and Professional office rules. “Add a rule for” offers All shops, Shops that sell food, Doctors (shops in a Health doctor category) and each shop type. How it works says “Doctors” means a shop in any Health doctor category (not Therapy or Diagnostics).

cases.title: A shop in a Health doctor category is asked for its medical registration with rule legalDocuments off, without blocking orders
cases.preconditions: Rule legalDocuments OFF (default). A live test shop of type Consultant / Professional Firm (appointments) with the shop category Cardiologist (Health — Specialists); repeat with Dentist, Ayurveda and Veterinarian.
cases.steps:
1. As the owner open Legal documents (/shop/legal-documents)
2. As a customer place an order or booking with the shop
3. As the owner upload the medical registration (number, council and a copy)
cases.expected: A “Medical registration” card: “Required for: Doctors and clinics (every Health doctor category)”, the badge “Required”, “Not uploaded” and an “Upload by <date>” note (20 Feb 2027 or later on staging); no “Your shop cannot accept orders” alert, and the customer's order or booking is not refused. After the upload: “Submitted — under review”, and the shop is no longer chased for it.

cases.title: Therapy and diagnostics categories are not doctors and are not asked for a medical registration
cases.preconditions: Rule legalDocuments OFF. A live Consultant / Professional Firm (appointments) shop whose only category is Physiotherapist (Health — Therapy); then only Diagnostic Lab / Pathology (Health — Diagnostics).
cases.steps:
1. As the owner open Legal documents
2. As admin open Shops missing documents
cases.expected: No medical registration card (with nothing else asked the page says “Licence uploads are not switched on yet.”); the shop is neither listed nor reminded for a medical registration.

cases.title: Doctor-category shops are reminded on the 1st / 15th and not suspended before the rule's date
cases.preconditions: A cardiologist shop as in TC-DOC-054 (before its upload), Shop Act verified, registered outside the signup wizard with no documents promise or waiver (a wizard shop is held to its own promised date instead). Developer help to trigger runs and move the Doctors rule's date (staging only).
cases.steps:
1. Open Shops missing documents
2. Trigger the follow-up on a reminder day and read the owner's reminder
3. With the developer move the Doctors rule's live_shops_due_at into the past and trigger reminder-day runs until 3 reminders have gone out
cases.expected: Badge “Medical registration due 20 Feb 2027”. Reminder: “… still missing: Medical registration (by 20 Feb 2027). GoKesari now needs this document from shops like yours, as the law requires. Please upload it by 20 Feb 2027. …” The shop is never suspended before the date; after it the run suspends it with “Reason: Shop documents needed for this type of shop not uploaded by <date>: Medical registration.” and admins and operators are told.

cases.title: A shop-type rule wins over the Doctors rule, and the shop-type screen shows no Doctors notice
cases.preconditions: A live Professional office — CA, CS, advocate, tax consultant shop that also picked Dentist; a live Doctor's Clinic; a new test user.

2. As the new test user pick Consultant / Professional Firm (appointments) on “Contact and shop details”

Doctor's Clinic: “Medical registration” from its own rule. Step 2: no medical-registration notice — shop categories are picked after payment (“7. What does your shop sell?”) and the Doctors rule is chased from then.

cases.title: The admin may change, extend or remove the Doctors rule

3. Add Fire NOC — Doctors — on the promise

With Fire NOC for Doctors the cardiologist shop's Legal documents shows a Fire NOC card (“Required”) and Shops missing documents lists “Fire NOC due <date>”; the physiotherapist shop is asked for neither. Every change has its audit row.

cases.title: Migration 0161 puts every built-in medical category in a Health group and adds the missing specialties

2. List the rows 0161 added

New consult categories (18): Cardiologist, Neurologist, Diabetologist / Endocrinologist, Gastroenterologist, Pulmonologist, Nephrologist, Urologist, Oncologist, General Surgeon, Orthodontist, Psychiatrist, Speech Therapist, Dietitian / Nutritionist, Unani, Siddha, Naturopathy, Diagnostic Lab / Pathology, Scan Centre (X-ray, sonography, CT, MRI), SAC 999312; new shop categories for those not already there (14). No row renamed, re-slugged or deleted; a row an admin had regrouped keeps its group; the Home care group is untouched.

cases.title: The registration category picker shows the Health groups and the new specialties
cases.preconditions: A live wizard shop at “7. What does your shop sell?” (or its category settings).

2. Search “Cardio”, “Scan” and “Siddha” in “Search shop categories”
3. Pick Cardiologist and save

cases.title: Find a doctor: pick a group, then a specialty shown with plain words
cases.preconditions: Rules health and consultBooking ON on test.gokesari.com. Verified test doctors in at least Cardiologist and Dentist. Signed in as the staging customer (or as a guest).
cases.steps:
1. Open Find a doctor (/health/doctors)
2. Read the Speciality rows
3. Tap “Specialists”

cases.title: Checks on a team member request

cases.title: Upload the signed consent letters; they are stored encrypted and open for admins
cases.preconditions: Signed in as Admin A. The pending request from TC-REFM-007 (S1 → D2, G2's code). Two dummy signed letters: owner.pdf (PDF) and d2.jpg (JPEG), under 5 MB.

cases.title: Wrong files and wrong document details are refused

cases.title: The admin who raised a request cannot approve or reject it

cases.title: A second admin cannot approve until every consent letter is in

cases.title: Reject, cancel and decided requests
cases.preconditions: Two PENDING requests raised by Admin A: R1 (shop S2 from D1 to D2) and R2. Admin B signed in in a second browser.

4. POST approve on R1 and cancel on R2 again

cases.expected: 1: “Request rejected.”; badge “rejected”; “Decision (<dd Mmm yyyy hh:mm> IST): No consent from D1”; S2 stays with D1. 2: 403 “Only the admin who raised the request can cancel it; another admin can reject it.” 3: “Request cancelled.”; badge “cancelled”. 4: 409 “This request has already been decided.” / 409 “Only a waiting request can be cancelled.” 5: 422 “Please check the highlighted fields.” (note of at least 5 characters; the UI keeps the buttons disabled).

cases.title: Every step of a move is in the audit log

cases.expected: referral_move.requested (kind, shops or member, from / to dealer, reason), referral_move.document per letter (kind, shop, size, type — no file content), referral_move.decided with decision APPROVED / REJECTED / CANCELLED, the note and, for an approval, the moved shops and the kept code; per moved shop dealer.attribution_changed with the previous and new dealer, member and code, the time and the reason. Actor and role on each.

cases.title: Approve: a shop with no code gets the team member's code

cases.title: Moving activated shops: earned commission stays with the old team, the new team earns from the move

cases.title: Approve a member move: he keeps his own code and his shops come with him

2. Read G1's places in dealer_salespeople
3. Read dealer_codes / referral_codes for C1 and for any code made for the new place
4. Read shop_attributions for S5 and G1's earlier ledger lines

cases.expected: 1: decision line ends “· keeps code C1”. 2: the old place in D1 is INACTIVE; a new place in D2 as AGENT under L2, ACTIVE, with the same account, PAN and bank details. 3: C1 is ACTIVE on the new place (dealer D2); the code made for the new place is RETIRED and its referral code INACTIVE. 4: S5 is now with D2 and the new place (source ADMIN); earlier ledger lines unchanged. 5: shops registering with C1 from now are attributed to G1 in D2.

cases.title: A moved team lead becomes an agent in the new team; his agents stay behind
cases.preconditions: D1 with team lead L1 who has agents A1, A2 and his own shop S6. Approved dealer D2. Admin A raises a member move for L1 to D2 with “Reports to the dealer”; Admin B approves after the three letters.

A1 and A2 stay in D1 (their lead slot is gone, so they fall under D1's missing-level rules) and their shops stay with D1. Recorded in code_check for the owner to confirm.

cases.title: Franchise recurring splits exactly at the move between two franchise teams
cases.preconditions: A staging franchise zone Z (not the admin test zone) where dealers X and Y each hold a paid franchise (sandbox). Shop SH (fee ₹1,000) signed by X's agent in Z, activated; one-time lines written for X's team. Orders of ₹1,00,000 delivered before the move. Request SH → Y (Y's agent) with the three letters; Admin B approves. ₹50,000 delivered after the move in the same month. Month calculation by the franchise job (1st of next month) or by the developer.
cases.steps:
1. Approve the move
2. Read franchise_shop_team_periods and franchise_shop_attributions for SH
3. Run the month's franchise calculation for X's and Y's allocations
4. Compare SH's one-time lines with before
cases.expected: 2: a team period for X (zone Z) with valid_to = the approval time; the attribution now owner Y, ACTIVE, attached_from = the approval time. 3: X's recurring ₹400 (20% × 2% × ₹1,00,000) and Y's ₹200 (20% × 2% × ₹50,000) for SH. 4: one-time lines unchanged (they stay with X's team).

cases.title: Moved to a team with no franchise in the zone: the shop is detached from the old franchise
cases.preconditions: Shop SH2 in zone Z attached to X's franchise. Dealer D2 holds no franchise in Z. Move SH2 to D2 with the letters; Admin B approves.
cases.steps:
1. Approve the move
2. Read franchise_shop_attributions and the history for SH2
3. Calculate the month for X's allocation
cases.expected: The attribution is REVERSED with hold reason “Moved to another team (Referral move …: <reason>)” and a history row (movedAt = approval time); a team period for X closes at the move. X takes the whole recurring on SH2 only for orders delivered before the move; from the move SH2 counts as a free-team shop of zone Z, so its recurring is shared among the zone's active franchises by the zone's split rule (X may get his share as one of them) instead of going to X alone.

cases.title: A shop moved before it is approved earns the new team's commission at approval
cases.preconditions: Rule dealerTieredCommission ON; D2 on the TIERED model with team lead L2 and agent G2 under L2. Shop S7 registered with D1's code, fee paid (₹999 slab), not yet approved. Move S7 to G2's code (letters in, Admin B approves).

cases.title: Admin → Dealers → Schemes lists the four schemes and their versions

cases.expected: /admin/dealers/schemes, title “Dealership & franchise schemes”, the “Create a new scheme” card (admin), then in order: Free Dealership (published · dealership), Business Partner (published · dealership), Growth Partner (published · dealership), Territory Franchise (published · franchise), each with “N dealers”. Free Dealership shows “Version 2 · published · Brief 23-Nov-2026” (open) and “Version 1 · superseded · Terms before 23-Nov-2026” with existing dealers counted on version 1. Each version shows its terms, “Why: …” and “Terms fingerprint” followed by 16 hex characters.

cases.title: The published terms read exactly as the owner's decisions D1–D3, D7

Business Partner: “₹11,000 + 18% GST = ₹12,980”; 25% one-time; “Recurring: 15% of GoKesari's commission, monthly, 12 months”. Growth Partner: “₹21,000 + 18% GST = ₹24,780”; 30% one-time; 25% monthly 12 months; “Team commission (level 1): 4% of shop registration fee”; “Team commission (level 2): 3% of shop registration fee”; Team building “Yes”. Territory Franchise: “₹1,50,000 + 18% GST = ₹1,77,000”; “Booked franchise zone · Shared · up to 2 per territory”; “Calculated by Franchise settings (existing)”; “Performance bonus: up to 5% of GoKesari's commission, monthly”. cases.title: Migration: every existing dealer has exactly one scheme and no money row changed

2. select count(*) from dealer_scheme_assignments where status = 'ACTIVE'
3. List assignments with source MIGRATION and their scheme / version
4. Check GoKesari Direct and the ledger / payout counts
cases.expected: 1 = 2 (one ACTIVE assignment per non-internal dealer). Dealers from before 23-Nov are on Free Dealership version 1 (source MIGRATION, reason 'existing dealer on 23-Nov-2026'), or Territory Franchise version 1 if they held a paid zone. GoKesari Direct has no assignment. Ledger and payout row counts and amounts are unchanged.

cases.title: Published terms, scheme history and acceptances cannot be changed

2. DELETE Business Partner v1
3. DELETE any dealer_scheme_assignments row
4. UPDATE accepted_terms of an ACTIVE assignment

cases.title: A new dealer starts on Free Dealership version 2; existing ones stay on version 1

3. Read the existing dealer's assignment
cases.expected: 2: one ACTIVE assignment on Free Dealership version 2, source AUTO, reason 'new dealer'. 3: still Free Dealership version 1 (MIGRATION), unchanged.

cases.title: Buying a franchise zone moves the dealer to Territory Franchise; a refund moves him back to his own Free version
cases.preconditions: Approved dealer DF on Free Dealership version 1. A regular staging franchise zone with a free slot (not the admin-only test zone: is_test bookings never change a scheme); sandbox payment (test payment page /orders/pay/sandbox/…, 'Pay (success)'). Admin A.

cases.expected: 2: Territory Franchise version 1 ACTIVE (source FRANCHISE_BOOKING, reason 'franchise zone <zone> paid'); Free v1 SUPERSEDED. 4: back on Free Dealership version 1 — his own version, not v2 (source FRANCHISE_ENDED, reason 'franchise ended: zone <zone> <status>'); the history keeps all three rows. A booking of the admin test zone leaves his scheme unchanged.

cases.title: The application shows the schemes to compare and choose

cases.title: A Free Dealership applicant submits without paying and his acceptance is recorded

Its terms, shown above, are part of the agreement.” and the box “I have read and accept the dealer agreement and my scheme's terms.” 2: “Application submitted. We will tell you when it is decided.”; status PENDING; no payment asked. 3: one acceptance, context APPLICATION, terms_hash = Free v2's fingerprint, the time, IP and browser; audit dealer.application_submitted with scheme {code FREE, version 2, termsHash}.

cases.title: Approval puts the dealer on exactly the version he accepted

cases.title: Terms that changed while the applicant was reading, or a scheme closed after he chose it

cases.title: Scheme chooser, joining charge box and questions on a phone

cases.title: Pay the Business Partner joining charge online, then submit

cases.title: Free Dealership v2: 20% one-time when the dealer's shop is approved

cases.title: One-time commission per scheme and fee slab

cases.title: Monthly commission: refunds, no sales, the 12-month limit, repeat close

A product is chosen without asking only when its score is at least 60 and 10 points ahead of the next. 2 → the command is checked again for that product and the proposal shows “price ₹40 → ₹42” with “Yes, publish”.

cases.title: Scan the barcode first, then say the change

cases.title: Publish a price after Yes: online and in-store price change with price history

cases.title: The published message shows the old price → the new price (fix #496)

cases.title: Price changed between showing and Yes: refused with the current price

cases.title: Say yes / no by voice on a phone

cases.title: Publish an offer by voice: a normal shop offer customers see

It is listed in Marketing → Offers where it can be edited or stopped. The customer sees ₹36 for Bread until the offer ends or is stopped.

cases.title: Offer length: “for 3 days”, “till tomorrow”, no end said (7 days) and the 90-day limit

cases.title: New price above the MRP is refused (Legal Metrology)

cases.expected: 1 → blocking “The price can't be more than the MRP (₹50).”; no Yes button. 2 → allowed (equal to the MRP). 3 → 422 “The price can't be more than the MRP (₹50).”; the price stays ₹45.

cases.title: Big drop warning: more than 50% below today's price

cases.title: Offer limits: percent 1–90, rupees off below the price, buy-X-get-Y not available
cases.preconditions: Flag `voice_price_assistant_enabled` ON (staging). Bread at ₹40.

(blocking when nothing else was said). 5 → 422 for percent 95 (1–90 only) and 422 “The rupees off must be less than the price.” Nothing is saved on a refusal.

cases.title: No offer on a product without a selling price, unless the price is said with it (fix #497)

cases.title: Flag off: no logo card; upload and remove answer 404; a logo set before stays

cases.title: Flag on: the owner uploads a logo and customers see it on the shop card

cases.title: Approved rider finds a verified society and asks to join with a note

cases.role: Society operator, Customer, Society admin, Operator
